links.outcome: Prospective performance of length-of-stay model in silent mode on live NHS admissions
links.effect: Random Forest mean precision 0.77 ± 0.03 and sensitivity 0.76 ± 0.04 during silent deployment (1,052 admissions), versus 0.88 ± 0.02 accuracy in retrospective benchmarking.
links.quote: The Random Forest model shows mean precision and sensitivity of 0.77  ± 0.03 and 0.76  ± 0.04 during NHS silent deployment (1,052 admissions).

links.outcome: Model length-of-stay prediction performance compared against clinician predictions
links.effect: Random Forest achieved the best length-of-stay prediction accuracy (0.88 ± 0.02), outperforming clinicians.
links.quote: Our models surpass clinician performance in length of stay prediction and show promise for case retrieval, supporting data-driven decision-making in paediatric cardiology and beyond.

screen.reason: Evaluates a length of stay prediction model and BioClinical-BERT similarity retrieval tool using both silent deployment (1,052 admissions) and a prospective ICU pilot measuring clinician utility.
